name: margins
description: Use your Claude Pro/Max subscription on your Obsidian vault. Reads markdown, proposes writes back, and compiles raw source files into wiki source pages.
long_description: Margins is an MCP connector that lets Claude read and propose writes to your local Markdown vault. All inference is paid for by your existing Claude subscription — no extra API key required. When you drop a folder of source files into raw/, Margins surfaces a priority queue and Claude compiles them into structured wiki source pages in ~90 seconds.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to your Markdown / Obsidian vault. Margins reads from here and stages proposals under proposed/.
